item.title: AstraZeneca Rare Disease Drug
item.description:
• Summary: AstraZeneca presented subgroup data from a Phase 3 study that missed its primary endpoint, in an effort to support an approval application for an undisclosed rare disease drug. The company believes the data in a specific patient subset may be sufficient for regulatory filing.
  • MoAs: N/A (drug mechanism not specified)
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Sanofi Venglustat NDA
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has granted priority review to Sanofi's New Drug Application for venglustat, an investigational therapy for a rare disease indication, potentially accelerating its approval.
  • MoAs: Glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
